works.body:
My name is Minato Ragi and I am a Vtuber and active in distribution.
Thank you for your skeb appeal!

Thank you very much for that! I would very much like to have you draw me again, so please do!
This time, I would be happy to draw you as you like, Qsiki!

Ragi Minato
X:https://twitter.com/minato_ragi/with_replies
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@ragi_vtuber

----------------------

China with black hair
She is a mature lady.
She has a mole under her right eye.
Mellow eyebrows
Brown skin
Sunglasses and a haori are optional.
Shoes
　Pinwheels for life-size dolls
　Flat shoes are OK for SD
Chinese clothing pattern (front: dragon, back: carp)

Poses, situations, etc. are up to you.
Since the model has changed, we would appreciate it if you could draw her with black hair and in the Chinese dress.
The coloring can be adjusted to match the design.
(Skin color must be brown).

----------------------

Usage
Thumbnails for YouTube distribution (already monetized)
Use on various SNS (X, Insta, TikTok).
Commercial use such as sales of goods.
If you have any items that cannot be used, please let us know in layers.

Format
We would greatly appreciate it if you could provide us with a format that separates characters and layers.
We would appreciate it if you could give us the data in PSD or PNG format.

Thank you very much.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19nDmyTfnFG63mYOchHFu2YwhvP7XQtoU

くぼsan, hello! Thank you for your appeal. I'm happy to hear that you like Clara. I liked the images on your Twitter. The variety of pictures you can draw is impressive. I would like a cute image where Clara has a smug face. I would like Clara to have some blood on her lips. I will leave the rest to you. I hope it will be fun to draw. Thank you for this opportunity.
